scenarios.title: Setting up the position
scenarios.ask: How many reference shares must the swap cover, and what is its notional amount?

scenarios.title: One day's change in value
scenarios.ask: What is the swap's unrealized gain, in dollars and per fund share? Which price of the reference security is the right one to use?

scenarios.title: Financing for one day and over a weekend
scenarios.ask: How much financing does the fund owe for each period?

scenarios.title: The floating rate changes
scenarios.ask: How much financing accrues over the three days?

scenarios.title: The reference security goes ex-dividend
scenarios.ask: What income is the fund owed, what is the change in unrealized gain, and what is the net effect on NAV on the ex-date? If the income is left out, by how much is NAV per share wrong?

scenarios.title: Rebalancing after a gain
scenarios.ask: By how many reference shares must the swap grow, and what is the unrealized gain afterwards?

scenarios.title: Rebalancing after a loss
scenarios.ask: By how many reference shares must the swap shrink, and what loss is realized on them?

scenarios.title: A reset and payment date
scenarios.ask: What net amount is paid, to whom, and what are the notional and the accruals afterwards?

scenarios.title: A creation for cash
scenarios.ask: What cash does the fund receive, how many reference shares are added to the swap, and what NAV per share is published afterwards?

scenarios.title: A redemption for cash
scenarios.ask: What cash does the fund pay, how many reference shares come off the swap, and what gain is realized on them?

scenarios.title: Posting collateral
scenarios.ask: What changes in the fund's books, and what is the effect on net assets?

scenarios.title: The management fee for one day and over a weekend
scenarios.ask: How much expense accrues for one day and for a weekend?

scenarios.title: The swap is valued at yesterday's price
scenarios.ask: By how much is NAV misstated if yesterday's price is used, in dollars, per share and in percent of the right NAV? Above what size must it be corrected?

scenarios.title: The reference security splits four for one
scenarios.ask: What are the units, the reset price and the unrealized gain after the split? What gain would the books show if the price were updated and the units were not?

scenarios.title: One whole day

given.expense_basis: 365 days, on the day's opening net assets

scenarios.ask: What NAV per share is published at the close, and how far is the day's return from twice the reference's return?
